title: Sensors That Fail Like the Field: Lidar, IMU, GNSS and Wheel Encoders, With Their Noise, Bias, Dropouts and Outliers

artifact.note: a 2D lidar that casts rays at walls and posts with noise and dropouts, an IMU with bias and bias drift, a GNSS receiver with fix levels and outliers, and a wheel encoder with quantisation, scale error and slip
